## Results

**Landed (R-2.4.1…R-2.4.5 S3 slices):**

- **`hh-context`** — `compact.rs`: `ClearToolResults` strategy —
  evicts only targeted *completed* tool invocations, never required or
  out-of-window items, I-CUT runs legal, `context.compaction.completed`
  carries `label_after` + `reclaimed` (I-LABEL). `retrieve.rs`:
  `StructuralIndex` (`anchors`/`idents`/`mentions` token-shape fold,
  `View`-stamped `ViewKind::StructuralIndex`), `structural` query
  executable (the C0 `IndexUnavailable` arm retired — acceptance test
  updated), `structural_pagerank` deterministic integer ranker, the
  on-demand fold as second implementation — indexed and on-demand
  agree (AC-R-2.4.3-7). `assemble.rs`: `activated{tool_used}`
  activation semantics + artefact kind/memory coverage on delivery
  rows. `s38.rs` (new): 9 tests — clear_tool_results both arms,
  structural index extraction/query/determinism, two-implementation
  agreement, M-CPE/X-CPE privilege-preservation fixtures (external
  memory never reaches privileged slots).
- **`hh-eval`** — `facts.rs`: artefact `kind`/`by_reference`/`signal`/
  `evidence_ref`, memory read/write/invalidation projections.
  `oracle.rs`: `trace_predicate` oracles — reacquisition,
  repeated_action, recall_probe (deterministic, `n/a`-classed without
  evidence). `context_metrics.rs` (new): the fold — overhead,
  compaction, compliance-chain counts plus `memory.validity_rate` and
  `memory.activated_given_delivered` ppm rates. `catalogue.rs`: every
  emitted row declared (incl. `compaction.applied`,
  `compaction.model_calls`, `memory.withheld`). `opacity_dynamic`
  verified (median/P95 ppm).
- **`hh-hir`** — `procedure.rs`: Stage-3 `select_target` — total and
  pure, workflow-node feasibility, typed refusals
  (`DelegationUnavailable`, `UnexpressibleSurface`, infeasible
  workflow), risk/evidence gating, profile-owned target differences,
  `CompileHint::Instruction` = default spelling (never an override),
  explicit infeasible targets refuse typed — no silent fallback
  (AC-R-2.4.5-4). Hook guards: `{narrow, additional_context?,
  replacement_proposal?}`; `allow` → `GuardReturnsAllow`. Corpus
  totality over ≥50 procedures.
- **`hh-lab`** — `procedure_test.rs` (new): `test_procedure` +
  `ProcedureConformance` — unbudgeted arm and missing `MatchSpec`
  refuse typed, revoked dependency → `stale-by-dependency`,
  undecidable → `unknown`, valid fixture reports cost under the
  instrument budget. `exemplars.rs`: five new recipes —
  `lab/context-builder-v1` (AC-R-2.4.1-12's matched arms),
  `lab/memory-compliance-v1` (AC-R-2.4.3-9's external-slot vs
  promotion-endorsed arm), `lab/memory-validity-v1` (AC-R-2.4.4-12's
  validity_filter × justification_scope × conflict_policy),
  `lab/procedure-execution-v1` (AC-R-2.4.5-10's target × profile with
  the interaction declared), `lab/retrieval-index-v1`
  (`structural_index`/`structural_pagerank` as a Lab arm).
- **`hh-registry`** — `skill.rs`: `export` — procedure → skill tree
  with declared losses, typed refusal on non-procedure input,
  claims-never-grants, opaque `CompiledPayload` scripts, content-
  addressed assets; lift/export round trip green.
- **`hh-compiler`** — `plan.rs`: workflow-node lowering + typed
  refusals; `s3_2.rs`: AC-R-2.4.1-13 — re-lower under
  `stale_signature = drop` lands profile-opaque items in
  `dropped_items[]` (typed `stale_signature`), `runtime_plan`
  unchanged, `model.surface.relowered` event carries the list.
- **`hh-ledger`** — `ViewKind::StructuralIndex` registered.
